sections.title: What's changing on January 11, 2027
text: Amazon has announced an update to its **Product bundling policy** that takes effect on **January 11, 2027**. Under the update, most product bundles listed as a single ASIN must be packaged by the original manufacturer or brand.

Amazon lists exceptions. These include bundles covered by a letter of authorization from the brands or manufacturers of all the products in the bundle, gift baskets in Amazon gifting categories whose product page clearly states that they are meant as a gift, bundles in camera product types, and bundles created with Amazon's Virtual Bundles tool. Amazon says that tool may not yet be available for every store, every brand, or every way you ship an order. Amazon is also removing some earlier bundle restrictions.
Amazon says bundles that still do not follow the rule after January 11 will be turned off and will show as listing problems on the seller's Account Health page, and that Amazon will email sellers.
sections.note: Sources are Amazon's announcement [New requirements for product bundles starting January 11](https://sellercentral.amazon.com/seller-forums/discussions/t/da850a57-839d-4e38-a96f-298dbc450b69) on the Amazon Seller Forums, from September 2026, and Amazon's [Product bundling policy](https://sellercentral.amazon.com/help/hub/reference/external/G200442350) page. Last checked October 21, 2026. Amazon can change its policies at any time, so always confirm in your own Amazon seller account.

sections.title: What we check
items: Whether a bundle looks like it was put together by the seller rather than packaged by the original manufacturer or brand

Whether one of Amazon's listed exceptions may apply. Those are a letter of authorization from the brands or manufacturers of all the products in the bundle, a gift basket in an Amazon gifting category whose product page clearly states the gift intent, a camera product type, or a virtual bundle made with Amazon's Virtual Bundles tool.
Whether the title includes the word Bundle
Whether the description says it is a bundle and names every item
Whether the first bullet point says it is a bundle of a stated number of items and names them
Whether the main image shows every item in the bundle and nothing that is not included

sections.title: What we don't do
items: We can't see who physically packaged a product, or check whether a letter of authorization is valid. Where that matters, we flag it for you to confirm.
We don't log in to your account, change your listings, contact brands, or file anything with Amazon.
We don't promise how Amazon will treat any listing. Only Amazon decides that.

faq.q: What is Amazon's new bundle rule?
faq.a: It's an update to Amazon's Product bundling policy that takes effect on January 11, 2027. Under it, most bundles listed as a single ASIN must be packaged by the original manufacturer or brand, with some exceptions. See [Amazon's announcement](https://sellercentral.amazon.com/seller-forums/discussions/t/da850a57-839d-4e38-a96f-298dbc450b69) for the official wording.

faq.q: What happens to bundles that don't meet it?
faq.a: Amazon says bundles that still do not follow the rule after January 11 will be turned off and will show as listing problems on your Account Health page, and that Amazon will email sellers.

faq.q: Which Amazon store does this cover?
faq.a: Amazon posted the update on its US seller forum, and we check against Amazon's US Product bundling policy. If you sell in another Amazon store, email us before you buy.

faq.q: What do I need to send you?
faq.a: The Amazon links or ASINs of your bundle listings, and the Amazon store you sell in, for example amazon.com. For the free check, send up to 5 listings and your seller name. The paid check covers up to 25 bundle listings from one Amazon seller account. Sellers with more than 25 listings should email first for a quote.

faq.q: Do you need my Amazon login or password?
faq.a: No. We never ask for your password or access to your account.
$29 USD, paid once, covers up to 25 bundle listings from one Amazon seller account. Sellers with more than 25 listings should email first for a quote.

faq.q: Can you guarantee Amazon will accept my listings?
faq.a: No. We review your listings carefully against the policy as Amazon has published it, but only Amazon decides how its policies apply.

faq.q: What if Amazon changes the policy?
faq.a: We check against the policy as Amazon has published it on the day we review your listings. If Amazon changes it later, your report won't reflect that change. See our [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/refund-policy/).

faq.q: Are you part of Amazon? Is this legal advice?
faq.a: No to both. {{name}} is an independent service, not affiliated with Amazon, and our review is not legal advice.
Payment is handled by Stripe. We never see your card number. If you have any trouble paying, email [{{email}}](mailto:{{email}}).

faq.q: Will I have to get on a call?
faq.a: No. There are no sales calls. You pay online and we talk by email.

faq.q: What if something is wrong with my report?
faq.a: Email us within 14 days of delivery and tell us what's wrong. We'll fix it, or refund you in full if we can't, as our [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/refund-policy/) explains.
